newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling slighty ahead of Eid.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling slighty ahead of Eid.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may continue to fall when the market reopens after the Friday weekend on lack of buying interest ahead of the Moslem Eid al-Adha festival later this week, brokers said.

"The market may remain depressed because of the forthcoming Eid. It may start recovering from the bearish trend after the festival," said broker Khurshid Alam. Brokers said blue chips in the engineering and leather sectors might fall.
The DSE benchmark index closed 7.76 points or 0.67 percent down at 1,140.26 on a turnover of 35.4 million taka on Thursday.
